note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of Citizen's official 1324 x 2048 front render at the listed 41 mm case width (= the coin-edge bezel, which overhangs the case); the bracelet then measures 19.4 mm at the lug tips against the listed 20 mm lug width. Heights are a front-relief reading of the listed 12.2 mm (side render). The dial, its prints, the date and the minute track stay in the dial map; the insert's silver prints are traced inlays.

review.subtitle: Citizen Promaster Fujitsubo, 41 mm titanium, blue dial, black insert in a blue coin-edge bezel, titanium bracelet. Front relief GLB, round 1.
specs: lug to lug in the render
notes: Modelled: blue coin-edge bezel ring, black insert with the silver numerals, bars, dots and triangle as traced inlays and a lume pip, applied rectangular indices with polished frames and lume, hour hand with a three-spoke lume ring and lume tip, minute hand with a lume panel, seconds hand with a lume dot, polished hub, fluted crown, brushed lugs, three-column bracelet (brushed outer links, polished centre links).
From the photo map: blue gradient dial with CITIZEN AUTOMATIC, DIVER'S 200m TITANIUM, the date (7) and the minute track; the crystal edge reflections near the rim are part of the photo.
Under the hands and indices the dial is a smooth fill of the gradient; it is covered by the 3D parts.
Scale is Citizen's 41 mm case width from the official straight-on render. Heights are a front-relief reading of the listed 12.2 mm. Titanium is shown with the house steel materials.
